summary: Tested the FMCC Polish Pass end to end: backend pytest (13 tests, 11 pass) plus Playwright on desktop 1920 and phone 390. WORKING: POST /api/scout/radar-compare returns role/roles/keys/labels/players/verdict, sends 422 for 1 or 5 ids and for a bad view, sends 404 for an unknown uid, has no ca/pa keys, and gives role values of null for a 0-minute player with verdict null. Radar Compare UI: profile-compare-with opens compare-dialog, search/pick adds players, radar-card draws an SVG, radar-kind tabs give 6/4/7 axes, the radar-role select changes the verdict, radar-verdict shows text and the 2 biggest gaps, the gap table appears at 3-4 players, the picker hides at 4 and comes back when you remove one, radar-missing shows for a low-minute player, Save image downloads fmcc-radar-compare.png and Print calls print. The Squad Players row opens player-sheet-compare-with and the same dialog works. Scout > More tools > Compare(2) shows radar-compare above compare4, and Breakdown now renders (fixes the iteration 33 failure). Editor Clubs queue (review off): toast says '1 change(s) applied to your save', it stays on /editor, a batch is created and the bell shows the notice. With review on, the toast says 'waiting in Game changes', it navigates to /changes and the change is queued. Punish queue auto-applies (backend). Phone top bar is one line (64px, no overflow), club name has an ellipsis, search/changes/connections/raw/tour/settings are hidden, and top-more-menu has all 5 items, which work. Contracts are grouped into one 'Contracts ending (8)' chip with its list. Rules impact is exact: squad target_minutes 0 gives 8 of 23, max_senior 11 gives 7, development needs_pct 100 gives 1 of 23, an unchanged draft gives 0, and the UI shows the same counts. Shaped loading placeholders (role=status) seen for dev, reports, elite and market. Pressing Enter on a row now keeps the profile open (iteration 33 bug fixed). No console errors apart from face-image 404s on the Editor. FAILURES: (1) CRITICAL: undoing an auto-applied Editor or Punish club change blanks the club value (sets it to None). (2) Screen tips are invisible and can't be clicked because of a CSS class clash. (3) ModuleGuide only records the first page it mounted on, so every other page shows the guide expanded on every visit.

critical.issue: auto_apply calls start_batch(career, ids) with no 'expected' map, so in sample mode apply_one (club branch) returns old_value=None. The change is stored as old_value None, and Undo then runs club_edits $set field=None, which blanks the club attribute. Reproduced: TEST FC training 7 -> auto-apply 5 -> undo -> None. AC Valdora reputation also ended up None after undo. I restored both by hand (training 7, reputation 4899). Fix: in apply_one's sample club branch, read the current value (editor_api.club_values) before writing and return it as old, or build 'expected' in auto_apply the same way /changes/preview does. Undo should also refuse when old_value is None.

minor.issue: Duplicate ids (e.g. [x, x]) are not rejected. The verdict then compares a player with himself. Add a uniqueness check (422).

It applies ALL queued changes from that source, including older ones queued while review was on. Also, PUT /api/features/review {on:false} only flushes elite/breakout/dp, so editor/punish changes queued under review stay queued after you switch review off.
Changing min_homegrown (and possibly max_team_drop/max_slot_drop) always reports 0 affected, because squad_outcome doesn't model homegrown. The count may not match what the rule really does.

ui_bugs.issue: App.css line 305 already defines .tip (pitch hover tooltip: position:absolute; opacity:0; pointer-events:none; bottom:calc(100%+8px)). The new .tip at line 396 doesn't override those, so every screen tip renders invisible (computed opacity 0, absolute, pointer-events none) and the dismiss button can't be clicked (Playwright: finance-strip intercepts pointer events). Rename the class (e.g. .screen-tip). Persistence works when dismissed by JS (fmcc-tips-seen).

visits is set once in a useState initializer of a component mounted once in App.js (not keyed by pathname). Only the first page is ever written to fmcc-guides-visited, so /squad, /development etc. show the guide expanded on every visit and after reload (verified: LS stays {"/":true}). Also, the write inside the useState initializer runs twice under React.StrictMode, so in preview the very first page (Home) is already collapsed on first visit. Fix: write visited in a useEffect keyed on pathname, or key ModuleGuide by pathname.
Window.print was called 2 times for one click (even with a single DOM .click()). Check this on a production build. It may be caused by the dev tooling, but it could open the print dialog twice.

integration_issues.flow: Editor club edit -> Game changes Undo
integration_issues.issue: Undo of an auto-applied club edit blanks the value (see backend critical).

issues: The collapsed guide on Home is about 300px tall because the 'what' text wraps in a narrow column next to the title. Stack it or hide the 'what' text on phones.
Radar axis labels are cut off left and right ('Progressive pas', 'Possession-adju', 'xpected assists'). Reduce the outer radius or shorten labels on small widths.
The radar-kind tab labels wrap onto 2 lines ('Role / fit', 'Phases of / play').
'Compare with…' and 'DOF report from the numbers' wrap onto two lines inside the buttons.
The note still says 'Changes go to Game changes, where you approve them as a batch…', which no longer matches auto-apply.

action_items: CRITICAL: make auto-applied club changes (Editor/Punish) record the real old_value in sample mode (apply_one club branch, or pass 'expected' from auto_apply), and stop undo from writing None.
Rename the new screen-tip CSS class: it clashes with the existing .tip tooltip (opacity 0 / absolute / pointer-events none), so tips are invisible.
ModuleGuide: record visited per pathname in a useEffect (or key by pathname). Don't write localStorage inside a useState initializer.
Phone: shorten or shrink the collapsed guide header and the radar axis labels and kind tabs at 390px.
Update the ClubsTab note to match auto-apply. Add scope='col' to the radar-gap-table th (Phase 3 accessibility standard).
Optional: reject duplicate ids in radar-compare. Flush editor/punish queued changes when review is turned off (or explain in the UI). Check the double print() call.
critical_code_review_comments: changes_api.apply_one (sample club branch) returns exp, which is None for batches made without a preview. Every non-preview path (auto_apply, queue_changes auto, features flush) records old_value None. For player entities, undo uses -delta so it's fine, but for club/target entities undo writes None.
ModuleGuide.jsx: side effects inside a useState initializer, and a per-mount (not per-route) visited snapshot.
App.css: duplicate .tip selectors at lines 305 and 396.
Some 'Loading…' text remains in PlayerTeamsEditor, FacePicker, Dossier, Recruit and ProfileSheet (not in the requested list).
RadarCompare gap table: th has no scope attribute.

success_rate.backend: 85% (11/13; the 2 failures are the same old_value=None bug)

seed_data_creation: No seed data. A TEST_punish punishment was created and deleted. Auto-applied batches on TEST FC (training) and AC Valdora (reputation) were created; values were restored to the originals (training 7, reputation 4899) through re-apply batches and a direct $unset of the None fields in club_edits. One review-mode queued change was rejected. Review switch reset to off. Squad/Dev rules were not saved (drafts cancelled).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Each browser_automation call is a fresh context. On phones nav-* links are hidden, so click them with page.evaluate("document.querySelector('[data-testid=nav-scouting]').click()"). Club 900000 = TEST FC (training 7), AC Valdora uid 910757 (reputation 4899). DON'T undo auto-applied club batches until the old_value bug is fixed: it blanks the value. The test file restores values by re-queueing instead. Squad impact: target_minutes 0 -> 8/23. Dev needs_pct 100 -> 1/23. Screen tip dismiss must use a JS click until the CSS clash is fixed.
rca of the issue: Undo blanking: auto_apply -> start_batch(career, ids) with expected={} -> run_batch -> apply_one sample club branch returns (exp=None, target) -> change saved with old_value None -> undo_batch sample club branch $set field: old_value (None). Repro: POST /api/editor/clubs/900000/attributes {values:{training:5}} -> POST /api/changes/batches/{id}/undo -> GET attributes shows training None. Fix: read the current value before writing in the sample branch. Invisible tip: CSS cascade of two .tip rules.
